selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a natural dependency chain. 'Find torch' requires the player to locate a torch in the environment, and 'light up a cave' requires the player to place torches to illuminate a dark cave area. The player must first find/obtain torches before they can use them to light up the cave. This creates a logical multi-hop sequence where resource acquisition precedes resource utilization. Both tasks are observable (torches are visible items, and cave illumination is measurable by light levels) and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge beyond basic item interaction.

edges.reason: Player must first locate and collect torches before placing them to illuminate the dark cave

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the torch display (4 torches on cobblestone walls at approximately x=-3.5, y=1, z=5 spawn-relative) and face toward them, confirming they have visually located the torches. Target is the center of the torch row, max_distance=16 allows spotting from a reasonable distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at them.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='torch') because lighting up a cave requires physically placing torch blocks inside the dark cave interior. The cave interior spans x=10-19, y=0-5, z=8-17 spawn-relative. A generous box of x=8-21, y=0-6, z=6-19 is used (±2~3 padding) to catch torches placed near walls or entrance. min_count=3 ensures meaningful illumination — placing at least 3 torches in a 10x10 room provides reasonable light coverage.

scene_description: A grassy area with 4 torches displayed on cobblestone wall posts (easy to find), a directional oak sign, and a large stone cave structure with a 2-wide entrance leading to a dark 10x10 interior room with a solid stone floor that needs lighting. Player starts with 10 torches in inventory.
task_text: Find the torches displayed on cobblestone posts nearby, then enter the dark cave and place torches inside to light it up.
design_notes: Spawn at center. Torches at x=-5 to -2, y=1, z=5 on cobblestone walls. Cave structure at x=7-22, z=5-20 with entrance at x=7-8, y=0-3, z=7-11. Cave interior at x=9-20, y=0 (stone floor), y=1-5 (air), z=7-18. Inner air space (cave_air) at x=10-19, y=1-5, z=8-17. Floor is solid stone for torch placement.
